eva_cs: Quick triage  Cohort Theta has 4 pending enrollments and only 2 seats left. Need final list, survey wiring, and renewal signal capture. Tagging @mike_ae @sam_prod @tereza_ops.
mike_ae: Which orgs are pending? any legal/billing holds?
eva_cs: Pending: NovaLife (procurement), RidgeAI (confirmed), HelioCare (pending legal), Brightline (confirmed). NovaLife has procurement notes from last quarter.
sam_prod: Let's add a 1-question renewal sentiment to prework: "How likely are you to move to production after pilot? (Unlikely/Maybe/Likely)" Also add expected QPS bracket.
tereza_ops: Ops will reserve 2 seats now and hold 1 for procurement for 48h. I'll wire the survey webhook to ops-tracker so completion shows in the dashboard. PagerDuty rule: if survey <50% at 36h, page AE.
engbot: Feature flag task queued: enable cusp_theta for confirmed orgs once roster posted. Dashboard created: seats_provisioned, survey_completion_pct, postkickoff_success.
eva_cs: Draft outreach (short): "Hi <Name>  welcome to CUSP Theta. Pick a kickoff slot (Wed 10:00 PDT or Thu 14:00 PDT) and complete this 4-question pre-kickoff survey: https://forms.redwood.example/cusp-theta. We9ll provision seats after slot chosen. Thanks! -Eva"
mike_ae: I'll nudge NovaLife procurement; if no response in 24h free the seat. Also will confirm attendee list so ops can pre-provision.
sam_prod: I'll add a 1-slide rollback/fallback note to the enablement deck for latency-sensitive customers and publish the updated deck to the repo.
tereza_ops: Action items: @mike_ae finalize roster by EOD; @engbot enable flags after roster; @sam_prod publish deck; ops will send invites and provision once roster final. I'll set renewal-risk tag for any org that doesn't finish setup in 10 days.
eva_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup: Call out any high-risk accounts here (procurement hang, low survey completion, or no-shows) and we'll escalate to AE + product.
mike_ae: Will follow up with NovaLife now.
engbot: Kickoff plan doc: https://docs.redwood.example/cusp-theta-plan (perms: customer-success, ops, product).
eva_cs: Rollup will be posted tomorrow AM. Thread closed when roster final.
